abstract: BACKGROUND: Recently, paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma has been described and related to an autoantibody. METHODS: We describe four patients with ovarian teratoma-associated encephalitis (OTE) and compared their clinical pictures with those of 17 previously reported patients with OTE. RESULTS: Clinically, OTE was characterized by the development of acute prominent psychiatric symptoms (20 of 21 patients), seizures (15 of 21 patients), and central hypoventilation (13 of 21 patients). Our patients had hypersalivation (three patients) and cardiac conduction problems (all patients); hypothermia was present in one patient. The mean time from the onset of OTE to tumor diagnosis was 19.6+/-22.1 weeks. Ventilatory support was required for 54.9+/-25.4 days on average. The white blood cell count in cerebrospinal fluid was 55.1+/-61.2/mm3. Twelve patients showed abnormalities on cranial MRI, involving areas such as the temporal regions (seven patients) or brainstem (four patients). In addition to tumor resection, 17 patients received some type of immunotherapy: 17 patients received corticosteroids, 10 received intravenous immunoglobulins, two received cyclophosphamide, seven received plasma exchange. Eighteen patients with OTE had neurological improvement, including 11 with full recovery. CONCLUSIONS: OTE presents with cardiac conduction problems and hypersalivation in addition to psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and central hypoventilation.

背景：近年、卵巣奇形腫に関連する傍腫瘍性脳炎が報告され、自己抗体との関連が示唆されている。
方法：卵巣奇形腫関連脳炎(OTE)の4例を報告し、既報の17例のOTE患者と臨床像を比較した。
結果：OTEの臨床的特徴は、急性で顕著な精神症状(21例中20例)、痙攣(21例中15例)、中枢性低換気(21例中13例)であった。本研究の4例では、流涎過多が3例、心伝導障害が全例に認められ、体温低下が1例にみられた。OTEの発症から腫瘍診断までの平均期間は19.6±22.1週であった。人工呼吸管理は平均54.9±25.4日間必要であった。脳脊髄液中の白血球数は平均55.1±61.2/mm³であった。12例で頭部磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)に異常を認め、側頭葉(7例)または脳幹(4例)などの部位であった。腫瘍切除に加え、17例が何らかの免疫療法を受けた:17例がコルチコステロイド、10例が静注用免疫グロブリン、2例がシクロホスファミド、7例が血漿交換を受けた。OTE患者18例で神経学的改善が得られ、11例は完全回復した。
結論：OTEは、精神症状、痙攣、中枢性低換気に加え、心伝導障害と流涎過多を呈する。
